items.name: astro-announce-bar
items.title: Announce Bar (Astro)
items.description: A one-line notice with a tag under the site's navigation, such as planned maintenance or a new feature. For a service's alpha or beta phase, use PhaseBanner.

items.name: astro-cta-band
items.title: CTA Band (Astro)
items.description: The closing call to action of a landing page: a title, short text, one primary action and an optional secondary one, on a Well or blue-wash band.

items.name: astro-feature-grid
items.title: Feature Grid (Astro)
items.description: A section that introduces what a service offers: a heading and intro, then a grid of features, each with an icon, title, text and optional link.

items.name: astro-hero
items.title: Hero (Astro)
items.description: The opening section of an agency or landing page, with the page's only h1, supporting text, up to two actions and optional media beside the text.

items.name: astro-logo-cloud
items.title: Logo Cloud (Astro)
items.description: A quiet row of the agencies or partners that use a service, muted at rest and in full colour on hover or focus. Each logo needs alt text.

items.name: astro-section-heading
items.title: Section Heading (Astro)
items.description: The h2 title and intro paragraph used by the marketing blocks. Use it to give your own landing page sections the same heading style.

items.name: astro-site-footer
items.title: Site Footer (Astro)
items.description: The large multi-column footer for agency and landing sites: agency name, address and social links, then groups of site links. Pair it with Footer.

items.name: astro-stats-band
items.title: Stats Band (Astro)
items.description: Two to four headline figures on a Well band, each with a label and optional footnote, and a source line. For landing pages, not dashboards.

items.name: astro-testimonial
items.title: Testimonial (Astro)
items.description: What people say about a service. One quote renders as a large centred pull quote; two or three render as a grid of Sheet panels.
